meta.title: Apply for Dental & Vision Coverage | Isaac Plans
meta.description: Start your dental and vision insurance application online — cleanings, exams, glasses and more. Secure, guided, and only a few minutes.
meta.imageAlt: Apply for dental and vision coverage with Isaac Plans

hero.title: Take care of your teeth and eyes for less
hero.subtitle: Most health plans leave dental and vision out. Start your secure application online — it only takes a few minutes.

benefits.title: Cleanings and exams covered
benefits.desc: Preventive visits are covered from day one on most plans — often with no waiting period.

benefits.title: Keep your own dentist
benefits.desc: Many plans let you stay with the dentist and eye doctor you already trust.

benefits.title: Affordable monthly cost
benefits.desc: Plans start at a few dollars a month, far less than paying out of pocket for a single visit.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Open your secure application
steps.desc: Tap Apply now and your private application opens immediately — no account, no password. Come back on this device anytime to pick up where you left off.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions about you and anyone else you want covered. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we review your application and contact you to finalize your plan and start date.

dentalVisionApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
dentalVisionApply.ctaNote: No account or password needed — your progress saves automatically as you go.
